data.name: Sunday Scaries
data.detailed_description:
There is no hope. There is no solution. 

This page (and game) are in early development. More information will be available soon; however, it's important to mention early on: unlike what the title and screenshots suggest, this game and its levels will dive much deeper than a basic critique of the modern workplace.

The screenshots above only relate to the game's first level. More detail will be provided on the themes of future levels as development progresses. See the 'Mature Content Description' below for more info. 

Want to stay updated with Sunday Scaries' progress? Check out the channels linked in the sidebar.

Also I'm a troglodyte and making this game solo but I'll do my best to cook up a banger for you my brother or sister.

data.short_description: An online co-op puzzle horror game with up to 4 players. Explore, solve puzzles, and defeat enemies to progress through story-driven levels that examine what it means to live in a decaying world without hope for the future.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features violence against the player characters and enemy characters, as well as NPCs on occasion. The game also frequently explores uncomfortable themes such as suicide, suffering, climate change, political corruption, religion, and more.
